analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.03) vs SMA5 ($1.03)/SMA20 ($1.07)/SMA50 ($1.08) — testing short-term resistance, below mid-to-long term averages.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($1.19)/SMA200 ($1.32) — indicating strong long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (0.8%) — trading near historical 52-week lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.5 → 38.2) — attempting to exit oversold but staying in neutral territory, showing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0013 → -0.0040) — in a bearish convergence, worsening, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $1.07) — trading around the middle band, with a narrowing band width of 11.29%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1.01) — based on 52-week low and Bollinger lower band.
· Swing Resistance ($1.13) — based on Bollinger upper band and Pivot R1; a break above could signal a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day low ($1.01) matches 20-day low ($1.01), 5-day high ($1.06) is lower than 20-day high ($1.16) — potential for sideways movement followed by weakness.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.80) — below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis — accumulation phase, continued sideways trading near 52-week lows, lacking clear direction.
